title: Formulas with cached values xlsx 003
notes: three real formula flavours with injected caches: IF(A1>40,...) -> string 'big' (needs t="str" on the cell, added during the zip rewrite), A2&"s" string concatenation -> 'cats' (t="str"), and =A1/100 displayed through a real number_format 0% (renders 50%, raw cached value 0.5 in <v>); reference text uses the raw stored values, not the formatted rendering. Recount asserts all three <f> nodes carry a <v> sibling.
